free_tier.stated: a 30-day free trial of Compute, Devboxes, GitHub Runners and more; the plans themselves start at USD 0 for a limited tier and are billed per minute above it
free_tier.notes: '30-day free trial of Compute, Devboxes, Github Runners, and more'

egress.terms: not published: no egress allowance or overage price on https://namespace.so/pricing and https://namespace.so/docs/workspaces/billing-and-limits.md

interface_detail: nsc CLI and devbox CLI with SSH into instances; a public API served over gRPC and Connect (listed as rest: no grpc term); TypeScript and Go SDKs

evidence.proved: '30-day free trial of Compute, Devboxes, Github Runners, and more'; a 2 vCPU / 4 GB shape is $0.002/min
the pricing page prices compute minutes with an overage rate and prints no egress allowance or overage price
evidence.quote: Prepaid cost is the effective cost of minutes in your plan, overage is the cost of any usage that exceeds your plan.

evidence.proved: the nsc CLI opens an SSH shell in an instance
a public gRPC/Connect API and SDKs (TypeScript, Go) exist
evidence.quote: The same API the SDKs use is public. It is defined in Protocol Buffers, published at [buf.build/namespace/cloud](https://buf.build/namespace/cloud), and served over gRPC and Connect.
